observations: Photo 0 shows a bare engine assembly sitting on a concrete/paved surface, removed from any vehicle.
Wiring harness, intake manifold, and various hoses/connectors are visible and intact.
A watermark reading 'TI AUTOMOBILE' is overlaid on the image.
No manufacturer badge, engine code plate, or model sticker is legible anywhere on the block or covers.
No vehicle, dipstick, or oil/fluid condition is visible; engine is not shown running or connected to any test rig.

claims.claim: Direct tokumbo engine (directly imported used engine)
claims.evidence: No import documentation, container photo, or identifying tag shown in photo 0 to confirm origin or import status.

risks.risk: Engine make, model, and displacement cannot be confirmed, which drives the entire price range for an engine.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate, casting numbers on the block, or a VIN-linked parts tag.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; price range for 'unknown engine' is too wide to set a worst case

risks.risk: Mechanical condition (compression, internal wear, whether it runs) is unknown from a static photo.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking/running, or a compression test reading.

risks.risk: Completeness cannot be confirmed - sensors, turbo, injectors, or accessories may be missing despite visible harness.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos (front, rear, both sides, underside) showing all accessory mounts and components present.

risks.risk: Fluid contamination or prior flood/fire damage not visible in a single ground-level shot.
risks.proof: Photos of oil on dipstick, coolant in reservoir, and any corrosion/water lines on the block.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine ID/code plate or stamped casting number on the block
Video of the engine running or at least cranking with sound
Photos from all four sides plus top and bottom of the engine
Any paperwork or customs/import documentation showing the tokumbo origin
response.reason: The photo shows a complete but unbranded engine with no readable model or code, so no worst-case price can be set until the make/model is identified; condition (running or not) is also unverified.
